step1.rule: STM-only-protect becomes the reference, and protect-user the eviction default, if it beats STM-only on after dependency checks (95% lower bound > 0) and its C-stable lower bound is > -5 points; otherwise the reference is STM-only

step2.rule: Each WM arm against the reference on after dependency checks, Holm-adjusted over the two WM arms. Keep WM if a WM arm's lower bound is > 0, its C-stable lower bound > -5 points and its whole-run tokens per passed task <= 1.5x the reference's (the best such arm sets WM's default policy under a host scope). Drop WM if both WM arms' upper bounds are < +5 points. Otherwise the owner decides

step3.rule: The reference against each baseline (memory-off-llm: LLM compaction; mem0) on after dependency checks, Holm-adjusted over the two baselines. The memory system beats a baseline if the reference's lower bound is > 0 and its C-stable lower bound > -5 points. Dev sessions decide the configuration only; the claim is read on held-out sessions (a later rule)
